jahati.p: [Hā+a+ti] (kri) CL=8 who give it up. (A) who abandoned it, (B) it is decayed (or) it is ruined. (C) it come to an end (or) cessation. (D) cut off. totally cut it off. it go beyond (or) it exceed (or) it overshoot.
